issues.description: hole_pattern docs say the grid is centred on `center` but do not state clearly that center is in absolute part coordinates (it is, since my plate corner is at the origin and center=(w/2,h/2) worked); only inferred from the example.
`cad set` leaves a params.toml with an override equal to the default after resetting; no `cad unset`/reset noticed.

Docs don't describe how to build a multi-part assembly with a motion parameter; I had to infer that returning a dict of Parts and rotating one part by a Parameter works. Rotation sign for 'swing toward +X' (rotate -a about y) had to be verified by measurement.
XZ plane offset=d places the sketch at Y=-d and extrudes toward -Y; computing Y layers needs care (negative offsets for +Y positions).

No one-shot clearance sweep across a parameter range (had to set angle, rebuild and measure distances manually). Only checked angles 0, 60, 90 by distance; clearance is guaranteed by the Y gap by construction.

No built-in way to declare an envelope/keep-out body and check clearance of parts against it (side-face 0.5 mm clearance, 7 mm shaft column); I verified by hand arithmetic from the model dimensions only.
Bash heredoc writes into the workspace needed approval in my sandbox; had to use the file Write tool. Not a cad problem.

Cutting a pocket from a given Z face needs extrude(plane='XY', offset=z) with a positive distance going +Z; this is inferable but not stated for pockets opening on a bottom face. A hex-pocket recipe would help.
Feature names containing a minus sign (e.g. 'screw-10') are accepted but produce awkward ref names like 'screw-10.side'.

suggestions.suggestion: State explicitly that hole_pattern center is in part coordinates, and the count=(nx, ny) order.
Add a cad unset/reset for parameter overrides.
Add a docs section on assemblies/motion parameters and a 'cad sweep PARAM a:b:n --measure ...' command.
Allow rotate to take an axis-through-point more explicitly in docs with a sign example for each axis.
Add a helper to build a reference 'envelope' Part that is excluded from export, with `cad measure --distance` between it and each part.
Add a vertical-column clearance query (cylinder of given diameter above a point) reporting any intersecting parts.
Document multi-part assemblies' section render naming (the sheet combines all parts into one image).
Add a hex nut pocket / captive nut recipe to the docs.
Offer a 'cad check' for interference between all parts in a multi-part project.
